# Version 3.119.2
> **Native hardening and diagnostic assets** · Released February 6, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.119.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v3.119.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.119.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.3/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.2 strengthens native binaries and makes Android native crashes easier to diagnose. The release also fills gaps in tvOS surface creation APIs without changing the engine milestone.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Security

- **Native binary hardening** — Enables Control Flow Guard across Windows native DLLs and buffer security checks for HarfBuzz and ANGLE. Adds Spectre mitigation compiler flags for SkiaSharp native libraries on Windows and Linux. — ❤️ [@Aguilex](https://github.com/Aguilex) ([#3397](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3397), [#3404](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3404), [#3497](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3497), [#3503](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3503))

## API Surface

- **tvOS surface creation parity** — Adds the missing SKSurface.Create overloads for tvOS. — ❤️ [@MartinZikmund](https://github.com/MartinZikmund) ([#3342](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3342))

## Platform

- **Android native symbols** — Preserves and packages Android native symbols to support crash investigation. ([#3374](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3374))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.3

HarfBuzzSharp Windows binaries gain Control Flow Guard and buffer security checks, and Android native symbols are preserved for diagnostics. These are package and native-build changes, not a HarfBuzz engine upgrade.
